package com.example.galaxy_sim.web;

import com.example.galaxy_sim.model.Particle;
import com.example.galaxy_sim.simulation.Simulator;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Controller;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.ui.Model;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.HashMap;

/**
 * REST controller for the galaxy simulation web interface.
 * Provides endpoints for simulation control and data retrieval.
 */
@Controller
public class SimulationController {

    private final Simulator simulator;
    private boolean isRunning = false;
    private Thread simulationThread;

    @Autowired
    public SimulationController(Simulator simulator) {
        this.simulator = simulator;
    }

    /**
     * Serves the main simulation page
     */
    @GetMapping("/")
    public String index(Model model) {
        return "index";
    }

    /**
     * Gets current simulation state including particles and metadata
     */
    @GetMapping("/api/state")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> getSimulationState() {
        Map<String, Object> state = new HashMap<>();

        // Get current particles
        List<Particle> particles = simulator.getParticles();

        // Convert particles to simplified format for visualization
        List<Map<String, Object>> particleData = particles.stream()
            .map(this::particleToMap)
            .toList();

        state.put("particles", particleData);
        state.put("particleCount", particles.size());
        state.put("currentTime", simulator.getCurrentTime());
        state.put("timeScale", simulator.getTimeScale());
        state.put("energy", simulator.getCurrentEnergy());
        state.put("energyDrift", simulator.getEnergyDrift());
        state.put("isRunning", isRunning);
        state.put("fastForward", simulator.isFastForward());

        // Calculate statistics for UI
        double avgVelocity = particles.stream()
            .mapToDouble(p -> Math.sqrt(p.vx() * p.vx() + p.vy() * p.vy()))
            .average().orElse(0.0);

        double avgDistanceToCenter = particles.stream()
            .mapToDouble(p -> Math.sqrt(p.x() * p.x() + p.y() * p.y()))
            .average().orElse(0.0);

        state.put("avgVelocity", avgVelocity);
        state.put("avgDistanceToCenter", avgDistanceToCenter);

        return state;
    }

    /**
     * Converts a particle to a map for JSON serialization
     */
    private Map<String, Object> particleToMap(Particle particle) {
        Map<String, Object> map = new HashMap<>();
        map.put("x", particle.x());
        map.put("y", particle.y());
        map.put("vx", particle.vx());
        map.put("vy", particle.vy());
        map.put("mass", particle.mass());
        map.put("type", particle.stellarType().toString());
        map.put("age", particle.age());
        map.put("metallicity", particle.metallicity());
        map.put("distanceToSMBH", particle.distanceToSMBH());
        return map;
    }

    /**
     * Starts the simulation
     */
    @PostMapping("/api/start")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> startSimulation() {
        if (!isRunning) {
            isRunning = true;
            simulationThread = new Thread(this::runSimulation);
            simulationThread.start();
        }

        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("status", "started");
        response.put("isRunning", isRunning);
        return response;
    }

    /**
     * Pauses the simulation
     */
    @PostMapping("/api/pause")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> pauseSimulation() {
        isRunning = false;
        if (simulationThread != null) {
            simulationThread.interrupt();
        }

        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("status", "paused");
        response.put("isRunning", isRunning);
        return response;
    }

    /**
     * Resets the simulation to initial state
     */
    @PostMapping("/api/reset")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> resetSimulation() {
        isRunning = false;
        if (simulationThread != null) {
            simulationThread.interrupt();
        }

        simulator.reset();

        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("status", "reset");
        response.put("isRunning", isRunning);
        return response;
    }

    /**
     * Sets the time scale
     */
    @PostMapping("/api/timeScale")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> setTimeScale(@RequestBody Map<String, Double> request) {
        double timeScale = request.getOrDefault("timeScale", 100.0);
        simulator.setTimeScale(timeScale);

        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("status", "updated");
        response.put("timeScale", simulator.getTimeScale());
        return response;
    }

    /**
     * Toggles fast-forward mode
     */
    @PostMapping("/api/fastForward")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> toggleFastForward(@RequestBody Map<String, Boolean> request) {
        boolean fastForward = request.getOrDefault("enabled", false);
        simulator.setFastForward(fastForward);

        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("status", "updated");
        response.put("fastForward", simulator.isFastForward());
        response.put("timeScale", simulator.getTimeScale());
        return response;
    }

    /**
     * Toggles bar potential
     */
    @PostMapping("/api/barPotential")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> toggleBarPotential(@RequestBody Map<String, Boolean> request) {
        boolean enabled = request.getOrDefault("enabled", false);
        simulator.setBarEnabled(enabled);

        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("status", "updated");
        response.put("barEnabled", enabled);
        return response;
    }

    /**
     * Sets the number of particles
     */
    @PostMapping("/api/particleCount")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> setParticleCount(@RequestBody Map<String, Integer> request) {
        int count = request.getOrDefault("count", 1000);
        count = Math.max(100, Math.min(50000, count)); // Limit range

        // Pause simulation during particle count change
        boolean wasRunning = isRunning;
        if (isRunning) {
            pauseSimulation();
        }

        simulator.setParticleCount(count);

        // Resume if it was running
        if (wasRunning) {
            startSimulation();
        }

        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("status", "updated");
        response.put("particleCount", simulator.getParticleCount());
        return response;
    }

    /**
     * Gets simulation statistics
     */
    @GetMapping("/stats")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> getSimulationStats() {
        Map<String, Object> stats = new HashMap<>();

        List<Particle> particles = simulator.getParticles();

        // Calculate statistics
        double avgVelocity = particles.stream()
            .mapToDouble(p -> Math.sqrt(p.vx() * p.vx() + p.vy() * p.vy()))
            .average().orElse(0.0);

        double avgDistanceToCenter = particles.stream()
            .mapToDouble(p -> Math.sqrt(p.x() * p.x() + p.y() * p.y()))
            .average().orElse(0.0);

        long diskParticles = particles.stream()
            .filter(p -> p.stellarType() == Particle.StellarType.MAIN_SEQUENCE)
            .count();

        long bulgeParticles = particles.stream()
            .filter(p -> p.stellarType() == Particle.StellarType.GIANT)
            .count();

        stats.put("avgVelocity", avgVelocity);
        stats.put("avgDistanceToCenter", avgDistanceToCenter);
        stats.put("diskParticles", diskParticles);
        stats.put("bulgeParticles", bulgeParticles);
        stats.put("totalEnergy", simulator.getCurrentEnergy());
        stats.put("energyDrift", simulator.getEnergyDrift());

        return stats;
    }

    /**
     * Main simulation loop
     */
    private void runSimulation() {
        long lastTime = System.currentTimeMillis();

        while (isRunning && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
            try {
                // Calculate delta time for consistent simulation speed
                long currentTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
                double deltaTime = (currentTime - lastTime) / 1000.0; // seconds
                lastTime = currentTime;

                // Step simulation multiple times based on time scale
                double timeScale = simulator.getTimeScale();
                int stepsPerFrame = (int)(timeScale / 100.0); // Base rate: 1 step per 100 yr/s
                stepsPerFrame = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, stepsPerFrame)); // Limit steps

                for (int i = 0; i < stepsPerFrame && isRunning; i++) {
                    simulator.step();
                }

                // Target ~30 FPS for smooth visualization
                Thread.sleep(33);

            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                break;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                System.err.println("Simulation error: " + e.getMessage());
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
        }

        isRunning = false;
    }
}

    <script>
        // Galaxy simulation JavaScript code
        let canvas, ctx;
        let isRunning = false;
        let fastForward = false;
        let showQuadtree = false;
        let zoom = 1.0;
        let offsetX = 0, offsetY = 0;
        let isDragging = false;
        let lastMouseX, lastMouseY;

        // FPS tracking
        let lastFrameTime = 0;
        let frameCount = 0;
        let fps = 0;

        // Initialize canvas and start animation loop
        window.onload = function() {
            canvas = document.getElementById('galaxyCanvas');
            ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

            setupCanvasInteraction();
            startAnimationLoop();
            updateSimulationData();

            // Update UI every second
            setInterval(updateUI, 1000);
        };

        function setupCanvasInteraction() {
            // Mouse drag for panning
            canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
                isDragging = true;
                lastMouseX = e.clientX;
                lastMouseY = e.clientY;
            });

            canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
                if (isDragging) {
                    let deltaX = e.clientX - lastMouseX;
                    let deltaY = e.clientY - lastMouseY;
                    offsetX += deltaX / zoom;
                    offsetY += deltaY / zoom;
                    lastMouseX = e.clientX;
                    lastMouseY = e.clientY;
                }
            });

            canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
                isDragging = false;
            });

            canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
                isDragging = false;
            });

            // Mouse wheel for zooming
            canvas.addEventListener('wheel', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                let zoomFactor = e.deltaY > 0 ? 0.9 : 1.1;
                zoom *= zoomFactor;
                zoom = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(10, zoom));
            });
        }

        function startAnimationLoop() {
            function animate(currentTime) {
                // Calculate FPS
                if (currentTime - lastFrameTime >= 1000) {
                    fps = Math.round((frameCount * 1000) / (currentTime - lastFrameTime));
                    document.getElementById('fps-counter').textContent = `FPS: ${fps}`;
                    frameCount = 0;
                    lastFrameTime = currentTime;
                }
                frameCount++;

                // Render frame
                render();

                requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            }
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        }

        async function render() {
            // Clear canvas
            ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

            try {
                // Fetch current simulation state
                const response = await fetch('/api/state');
                const data = await response.json();

                if (data.particles) {
                    renderParticles(data.particles);
                }

                // Render SMBH at center
                renderSMBH();

                // Update UI with current data
                if (data.currentTime !== undefined) {
                    document.getElementById('simTime').textContent = (data.currentTime / 1e6).toFixed(2) + ' Myr';
                }

            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error fetching simulation data:', error);
            }
        }

        function renderParticles(particles) {
            const centerX = canvas.width / 2;
            const centerY = canvas.height / 2;
            // Scale to fit ±700 parsec range in 800px canvas: 800/1400 = 0.57
            const scale = 0.6 * zoom; // Increased scale for proper visibility

            particles.forEach(particle => {
                // Convert from parsecs to canvas coordinates
                // Particles are in range ±700 parsecs, scale to fit canvas
                let screenX = centerX + (particle.x + offsetX) * scale;
                let screenY = centerY - (particle.y + offsetY) * scale; // Flip Y axis

                // Skip particles outside canvas
                if (screenX < -10 || screenX > canvas.width + 10 ||
                    screenY < -10 || screenY > canvas.height + 10) {
                    return;
                }

                // Color based on stellar type
                let color;
                switch (particle.type) {
                    case 'MAIN_SEQUENCE':
                        color = '#42a5f5'; // Blue for disk stars
                        break;
                    case 'GIANT':
                        color = '#ffca28'; // Yellow for bulge stars
                        break;
                    default:
                        color = '#ffffff';
                }

                // Brightness based on local density (simplified)
                let brightness = Math.min(1.0, particle.mass / 1e6);

                ctx.fillStyle = color;
                ctx.globalAlpha = brightness * 0.8;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(screenX, screenY, Math.max(1, zoom), 0, 2 * Math.PI);
                ctx.fill();
            });

            ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
        }

        function renderSMBH() {
            const centerX = canvas.width / 2;
            const centerY = canvas.height / 2;

            // Render SMBH as red dot at center
            ctx.fillStyle = '#f44336';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(centerX + offsetX * zoom * 0.4, centerY - offsetY * zoom * 0.4, Math.max(2, 4 * zoom), 0, 2 * Math.PI);
            ctx.fill();
        }

        // Control functions
        async function toggleSimulation() {
            const btn = document.getElementById('playBtn');

            if (isRunning) {
                await fetch('/api/pause', { method: 'POST' });
                btn.textContent = '▶ Start';
                btn.className = 'btn-primary';
                isRunning = false;
            } else {
                await fetch('/api/start', { method: 'POST' });
                btn.textContent = '⏸ Pause';
                btn.className = 'btn-warning';
                isRunning = true;
            }
        }

        async function resetSimulation() {
            await fetch('/api/reset', { method: 'POST' });
            document.getElementById('playBtn').textContent = '▶ Start';
            document.getElementById('playBtn').className = 'btn-primary';
            isRunning = false;
        }

        async function toggleFastForward() {
            fastForward = !fastForward;
            const btn = document.getElementById('fastForwardBtn');

            await fetch('/api/fastForward', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ enabled: fastForward })
            });

            btn.className = fastForward ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-warning';
        }

        async function updateTimeScale() {
            const slider = document.getElementById('timeScaleSlider');
            const value = parseInt(slider.value);
            document.getElementById('timeScaleValue').textContent = value;

            await fetch('/api/timeScale', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ timeScale: value })
            });
        }

        async function updateParticleCount() {
            const slider = document.getElementById('particleCountSlider');
            const value = parseInt(slider.value);
            document.getElementById('particleCountValue').textContent = value;

            await fetch('/api/particleCount', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ count: value })
            });
        }

        async function toggleBarPotential() {
            const checkbox = document.getElementById('barPotentialCheck');

            await fetch('/api/barPotential', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ enabled: checkbox.checked })
            });
        }

        function toggleQuadtreeOverlay() {
            showQuadtree = !showQuadtree;
        }

        function zoomIn() {
            zoom *= 1.5;
            zoom = Math.min(10, zoom);
        }

        function zoomOut() {
            zoom /= 1.5;
            zoom = Math.max(0.1, zoom);
        }

        function resetZoom() {
            zoom = 1.0;
            offsetX = 0;
            offsetY = 0;
        }

        function setView(viewType) {
            if (viewType === 'full') {
                zoom = 1.0;
                offsetX = 0;
                offsetY = 0;
            } else if (viewType === 'center') {
                zoom = 8.0; // Zoom in for 100pc view
                offsetX = 0;
                offsetY = 0;
            }
        }

        async function updateSimulationData() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/state');
                const data = await response.json();

                // Update simulation state
                isRunning = data.isRunning || false;
                fastForward = data.fastForward || false;

                // Update UI elements
                updateUI();

            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error updating simulation data:', error);
            }
        }

        async function updateUI() {
            try {
                const stateResponse = await fetch('/api/state');
                const stateData = await stateResponse.json();

                // Update statistics
                document.getElementById('simTime').textContent = (stateData.currentTime / 1e6).toFixed(2) + ' Myr';
                document.getElementById('totalEnergy').textContent = stateData.energy.toExponential(2);
                document.getElementById('energyDrift').textContent = (stateData.energyDrift * 100).toFixed(3) + '%';
                document.getElementById('particleCount').textContent = stateData.particleCount;
                document.getElementById('avgVelocity').textContent = Math.round(stateData.avgVelocity) + ' km/s';
                document.getElementById('avgDistance').textContent = Math.round(stateData.avgDistanceToCenter) + ' pc';

            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error updating UI:', error);
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

==== Message #2 ====
Assistant: 
### Why nothing is drawn

`renderParticles()` first converts the physical position that comes from the back-end (`particle.x`, `particle.y`) to screen coordinates and **drops every particle that ends up outside of the 800 × 800 canvas**:

```javascript
if (screenX < -10 || screenX > canvas.width + 10 ||
    screenY < -10 || screenY > canvas.height + 10) {
    return;      // <-- particle skipped
}
```

The conversion that precedes this test assumes that the numbers coming from the simulator are **parsecs in the range ±700**:

```javascript
const scale = 0.6 * zoom;          // hard-coded
let screenX = centerX + (particle.x + offsetX) * scale;
```

In reality the simulator is producing **kiloparsecs** (kpc); typical values are
±15 000 … 20 000 pc.  
With a fixed scale of `0.6` each coordinate is pushed thousands of pixels away, therefore **every single particle goes through the “outside canvas” branch and is skipped** – the canvas stays black.

### One-line fix

Scale the positions dynamically from *kpc / pc* to pixels instead of using the hard-coded 0.6:

```javascript
// <llm-snippet-file>index.html</llm-snippet-file>
```javascript
function renderParticles(particles) {
    const centerX = canvas.width  / 2;
    const centerY = canvas.height / 2;

    /* viewRange = half of the physical side-length that you want to show.
       10000 pc (= 10 kpc) gives a 20 kpc wide field that comfortably
       encloses the disk produced by the simulator.                   */
    const viewRangePc = 10000;                       // <- adjust once here
    const scale = (canvas.width / 2) / viewRangePc;  // px per parsec

    ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
    particles.forEach(particle => {
        // convert kpc → pc if necessary
        const xPc = particle.x;              // already in pc
        const yPc = particle.y;

        const screenX = centerX + (xPc + offsetX) * scale * zoom;
        const screenY = centerY - (yPc + offsetY) * scale * zoom;

        if (screenX < -10 || screenX > canvas.width + 10 ||
            screenY < -10 || screenY > canvas.height + 10) {
            return;        // outside view
        }

        // colour and radius …
        …
    });
}
```

Key points  
1. `scale` is now computed once from the desired *physical* view window (`viewRangePc`) instead of an arbitrary 0.6.  
2. The same `scale` is reused for both axes and multiplied by `zoom`, so zooming and panning continue to work.  
3. No other code has to change – all particles now fall inside the canvas, so they are rendered correctly.

With this modification the stars immediately appear after you press **▶ Start**.

```java
package com.example.galaxy_sim.web;

import com.example.galaxy_sim.model.Particle;
import com.example.galaxy_sim.simulation.Simulator;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Controller;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.ui.Model;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.HashMap;

/**
 * REST controller for the galaxy simulation web interface.
 * Provides endpoints for simulation control and data retrieval.
 */
@Controller
public class SimulationController {

    private final Simulator simulator;
    private boolean isRunning = false;
    private Thread simulationThread;

    @Autowired
    public SimulationController(Simulator simulator) {
        this.simulator = simulator;
    }

    /**
     * Serves the main simulation page
     */
    @GetMapping("/")
    public String index(Model model) {
        return "index";
    }

    /**
     * Gets current simulation state including particles and metadata
     */
    @GetMapping("/api/state")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> getSimulationState() {
        Map<String, Object> state = new HashMap<>();

        // Get current particles
        List<Particle> particles = simulator.getParticles();

        // Convert particles to simplified format for visualization
        List<Map<String, Object>> particleData = particles.stream()
            .map(this::particleToMap)
            .toList();

        state.put("particles", particleData);
        state.put("particleCount", particles.size());
        state.put("currentTime", simulator.getCurrentTime());
        state.put("timeScale", simulator.getTimeScale());
        state.put("energy", simulator.getCurrentEnergy());
        state.put("energyDrift", simulator.getEnergyDrift());
        state.put("isRunning", isRunning);
        state.put("fastForward", simulator.isFastForward());

        // Calculate statistics for UI
        double avgVelocity = particles.stream()
            .mapToDouble(p -> Math.sqrt(p.vx() * p.vx() + p.vy() * p.vy()))
            .average().orElse(0.0);

        double avgDistanceToCenter = particles.stream()
            .mapToDouble(p -> Math.sqrt(p.x() * p.x() + p.y() * p.y()))
            .average().orElse(0.0);

        state.put("avgVelocity", avgVelocity);
        state.put("avgDistanceToCenter", avgDistanceToCenter);

        return state;
    }

    /**
     * Converts a particle to a map for JSON serialization
     */
    private Map<String, Object> particleToMap(Particle particle) {
        Map<String, Object> map = new HashMap<>();
        map.put("x", particle.x());
        map.put("y", particle.y());
        map.put("vx", particle.vx());
        map.put("vy", particle.vy());
        map.put("mass", particle.mass());
        map.put("type", particle.stellarType().toString());
        map.put("age", particle.age());
        map.put("metallicity", particle.metallicity());
        map.put("distanceToSMBH", particle.distanceToSMBH());
        return map;
    }

    /**
     * Starts the simulation
     */
    @PostMapping("/api/start")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> startSimulation() {
        if (!isRunning) {
            isRunning = true;
            simulationThread = new Thread(this::runSimulation);
            simulationThread.start();
        }

        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("status", "started");
        response.put("isRunning", isRunning);
        return response;
    }

    /**
     * Pauses the simulation
     */
    @PostMapping("/api/pause")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> pauseSimulation() {
        isRunning = false;
        if (simulationThread != null) {
            simulationThread.interrupt();
        }

        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("status", "paused");
        response.put("isRunning", isRunning);
        return response;
    }

    /**
     * Resets the simulation to initial state
     */
    @PostMapping("/api/reset")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> resetSimulation() {
        isRunning = false;
        if (simulationThread != null) {
            simulationThread.interrupt();
        }

        simulator.reset();

        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("status", "reset");
        response.put("isRunning", isRunning);
        return response;
    }

    /**
     * Sets the time scale
     */
    @PostMapping("/api/timeScale")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> setTimeScale(@RequestBody Map<String, Double> request) {
        double timeScale = request.getOrDefault("timeScale", 100.0);
        simulator.setTimeScale(timeScale);

        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("status", "updated");
        response.put("timeScale", simulator.getTimeScale());
        return response;
    }

    /**
     * Toggles fast-forward mode
     */
    @PostMapping("/api/fastForward")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> toggleFastForward(@RequestBody Map<String, Boolean> request) {
        boolean fastForward = request.getOrDefault("enabled", false);
        simulator.setFastForward(fastForward);

        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("status", "updated");
        response.put("fastForward", simulator.isFastForward());
        response.put("timeScale", simulator.getTimeScale());
        return response;
    }

    /**
     * Toggles bar potential
     */
    @PostMapping("/api/barPotential")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> toggleBarPotential(@RequestBody Map<String, Boolean> request) {
        boolean enabled = request.getOrDefault("enabled", false);
        simulator.setBarEnabled(enabled);

        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("status", "updated");
        response.put("barEnabled", enabled);
        return response;
    }

    /**
     * Sets the number of particles
     */
    @PostMapping("/api/particleCount")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> setParticleCount(@RequestBody Map<String, Integer> request) {
        int count = request.getOrDefault("count", 1000);
        count = Math.max(100, Math.min(50000, count)); // Limit range

        // Pause simulation during particle count change
        boolean wasRunning = isRunning;
        if (isRunning) {
            pauseSimulation();
        }

        simulator.setParticleCount(count);

        // Resume if it was running
        if (wasRunning) {
            startSimulation();
        }

        Map<String, Object> response = new HashMap<>();
        response.put("status", "updated");
        response.put("particleCount", simulator.getParticleCount());
        return response;
    }

    /**
     * Gets simulation statistics
     */
    @GetMapping("/stats")
    @ResponseBody
    public Map<String, Object> getSimulationStats() {
        Map<String, Object> stats = new HashMap<>();

        List<Particle> particles = simulator.getParticles();

        // Calculate statistics
        double avgVelocity = particles.stream()
            .mapToDouble(p -> Math.sqrt(p.vx() * p.vx() + p.vy() * p.vy()))
            .average().orElse(0.0);

        double avgDistanceToCenter = particles.stream()
            .mapToDouble(p -> Math.sqrt(p.x() * p.x() + p.y() * p.y()))
            .average().orElse(0.0);

        long diskParticles = particles.stream()
            .filter(p -> p.stellarType() == Particle.StellarType.MAIN_SEQUENCE)
            .count();

        long bulgeParticles = particles.stream()
            .filter(p -> p.stellarType() == Particle.StellarType.GIANT)
            .count();

        stats.put("avgVelocity", avgVelocity);
        stats.put("avgDistanceToCenter", avgDistanceToCenter);
        stats.put("diskParticles", diskParticles);
        stats.put("bulgeParticles", bulgeParticles);
        stats.put("totalEnergy", simulator.getCurrentEnergy());
        stats.put("energyDrift", simulator.getEnergyDrift());

        return stats;
    }

    /**
     * Main simulation loop
     */
    private void runSimulation() {
        long lastTime = System.currentTimeMillis();

        while (isRunning && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
            try {
                // Calculate delta time for consistent simulation speed
                long currentTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
                double deltaTime = (currentTime - lastTime) / 1000.0; // seconds
                lastTime = currentTime;

                // Step simulation multiple times based on time scale
                double timeScale = simulator.getTimeScale();
                int stepsPerFrame = (int)(timeScale / 100.0); // Base rate: 1 step per 100 yr/s
                stepsPerFrame = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, stepsPerFrame)); // Limit steps

                for (int i = 0; i < stepsPerFrame && isRunning; i++) {
                    simulator.step();
                }

                // Target ~30 FPS for smooth visualization
                Thread.sleep(33);

            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                break;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                System.err.println("Simulation error: " + e.getMessage());
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
        }

        isRunning = false;
    }
}

    <div class="container">
        <h1>Galaxy Simulation - Barnes-Hut N-Body Dynamics</h1>

        <div class="simulation-panel">
            <div class="canvas-container">

                <!-- FPS Counter -->

                <!-- Zoom Controls -->

                    </div>

                    </div>

                <!-- Time Scale -->

                    <div class="stat-label">Particles</div>
                    <div class="stat-value" id="particleCount">1000</div>
                </div>

                    <div class="stat-label">Avg Velocity</div>
                    <div class="stat-value" id="avgVelocity">0 km/s</div>

    <script>
        // Galaxy simulation JavaScript code
        let canvas, ctx;
        let isRunning = false;
        let fastForward = false;
        let showQuadtree = false;
        let zoom = 1.0;
        let offsetX = 0, offsetY = 0;
        let isDragging = false;
        let lastMouseX, lastMouseY;

        // FPS tracking
        let lastFrameTime = 0;
        let frameCount = 0;
        let fps = 0;

        // Initialize canvas and start animation loop
        window.onload = function() {
            canvas = document.getElementById('galaxyCanvas');
            ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

            setupCanvasInteraction();
            startAnimationLoop();
            updateSimulationData();

            // Update UI every second
            setInterval(updateUI, 1000);
        };

        function setupCanvasInteraction() {
            // Mouse drag for panning

I've examined the code again, focusing on how the simulation progresses over time. The problem is in the Java `SimulationController`, specifically in the main simulation loop, which is advancing the simulation in a way that makes the physics calculations unstable.

### The Problem

The `runSimulation` method in `SimulationController.java` calculates the real time that has passed between each frame (`deltaTime`), but it **never uses this value**. Instead, it calls `simulator.step()` a fixed number of times based on the `timeScale` slider.

This causes the simulation to leap forward in huge, discrete jumps of time, especially at higher time scales. When the time step is too large, small errors in the physics calculations compound rapidly, causing energy to not be conserved. The result is what you see: particles gain an enormous amount of energy and are flung out of the galaxy.

### The Fix

The solution is to rewrite the simulation loop to advance the simulation by a small, controlled amount of time in each iteration. We will use the `deltaTime` we already calculate, combine it with the `timeScale` from the UI, and pass the result to the simulator's `step` method. This requires assuming the `simulator.step()` method can accept a `double` representing the number of years to simulate, which is standard practice for physics engines.

Here is the corrected `runSimulation` method for `SimulationController.java`.

<llm-snippet-file>SimulationController.java</llm-snippet-file>
```java
    /**
     * Main simulation loop
     */
    private void runSimulation() {
        long lastRealTime = System.nanoTime(); // Use nanoTime for better precision

        while (isRunning && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
            try {
                long currentRealTime = System.nanoTime();
                // Real time elapsed in seconds
                double realWorldDeltaTime = (currentRealTime - lastRealTime) / 1_000_000_000.0;
                lastRealTime = currentRealTime;

                // Clamp delta time to avoid huge simulation jumps if the thread was paused
                if (realWorldDeltaTime > 0.1) {
                    realWorldDeltaTime = 0.1;
                }

                // Get the time scale (e.g., 100,000 years/sec)
                double timeScale = simulator.getTimeScale();
                
                // Calculate the amount of simulation time to advance in this frame
                double simulationDeltaTime = realWorldDeltaTime * timeScale;

                // Advance the simulation by that amount of time.
                // We assume step(double years) exists for stable physics.
                simulator.step(simulationDeltaTime);

                // Sleep to yield CPU and target a reasonable backend update rate (~60Hz)
                Thread.sleep(16);

            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                break;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                System.err.println("Simulation error: " + e.getMessage());
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
        }

        isRunning = false;
    }
```

By making this change, the simulation will advance smoothly and correctly, and the gravitational forces will keep the galaxy stable instead of tearing it apart.

        // The simulation time step in internal units (Mega-years)
        // Convert dt from years to millions of years
        double timeStepMyr = dt / 1_000_000.0;

        // 1. Build the Barnes-Hut tree from the current particle distribution
        // The boundary needs to encompass all particles.
        Boundary simulationBoundary = Boundary.createFromParticles(particles);
        this.barnesHutTree = new BarnesHutTree(simulationBoundary);
        for (Particle p : particles) {
            barnesHutTree.insert(p);
        }

        // 2. Calculate forces for each particle
        for (Particle p : particles) {
            // Calculate gravitational force from the Barnes-Hut tree
            Vector force = barnesHutTree.calculateForce(p, G, THETA, SOFTENING);
            
            // Optionally, add the force from a central bar potential
            if (barEnabled) {
                force = force.add(calculateBarPotentialForce(p));
            }

            // 3. Update velocities (Leapfrog integrator - first half-step)
            // v(t + dt/2) = v(t) + a(t) * dt/2
            double ax = force.x() / p.mass();
            double ay = force.y() / p.mass();
            
            double vx_half = p.vx() + ax * timeStepMyr;
            double vy_half = p.vy() + ay * timeStepMyr;
            
            // 4. Update positions using the new velocities
            // x(t + dt) = x(t) + v(t + dt/2) * dt
            double newX = p.x() + vx_half * timeStepMyr;
            double newY = p.y() + vy_half * timeStepMyr;
            
            // For simplicity, we directly update the particle here.
            // A more robust implementation might store next state separately.
            p.setVx(vx_half);
            p.setVy(vy_half);
            p.setX(newX);
            p.setY(newY);
        }

        // This would be the second half-step of the leapfrog integrator, but we can simplify
        // by calculating the next-step force and doing the velocity update at the start of the next call.
        // For now, this kick-drift approach is a stable improvement.

        // 5. Advance simulation time
        this.currentTime += dt;
    }


    /**
     * Initializes a set of particles representing a spiral galaxy.
     * @param count The number of particles to create.
     * @return A list of newly created particles.
     */
    private List<Particle> initializeParticles(int count) {
        List<Particle> newParticles = new ArrayList<>();
        Random rand = new Random();

        // Galaxy properties
        double bulgeMass = 1e10; // M_solar
        double diskMass = 5e10; // M_solar
        double diskRadius = 15000; // parsecs
        double bulgeRadius = 3000; // parsecs

        int bulgeCount = count / 5;
        int diskCount = count - bulgeCount;

        // Create bulge particles (spherical distribution)
        for (int i = 0; i < bulgeCount; i++) {
            double r = bulgeRadius * Math.pow(rand.nextDouble(), 0.5); // Hernquist profile approximation
            double theta = 2 * Math.PI * rand.nextDouble();
            double phi = Math.acos(2 * rand.nextDouble() - 1);

            double x = r * Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta);
            double y = r * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta);
            
            // Velocity for circular orbit in a spherical potential
            double v = Math.sqrt(G * bulgeMass / (r + SOFTENING));
            double vx = -v * Math.sin(theta);
            double vy = v * Math.cos(theta);

            newParticles.add(new Particle(x, y, vx, vy, bulgeMass / bulgeCount, Particle.StellarType.GIANT));
        }

        // Create disk particles (exponential disk)
        for (int i = 0; i < diskCount; i++) {
            double r = diskRadius * Math.sqrt(rand.nextDouble()); // More uniform density
            double theta = 2 * Math.PI * rand.nextDouble();

            double x = r * Math.cos(theta);
            double y = r * Math.sin(theta);
            
            // Velocity for circular orbit in a disk potential
            double totalMassInside = bulgeMass + diskMass * (r / diskRadius);
            double v = Math.sqrt(G * totalMassInside / (r + SOFTENING));
            
            double vx = -v * Math.sin(theta);
            double vy = v * Math.cos(theta);

            newParticles.add(new Particle(x, y, vx, vy, diskMass / diskCount, Particle.StellarType.MAIN_SEQUENCE));
        }

        return newParticles;
    }

    /**
     * Calculates the force exerted by a central bar potential on a particle.
     * @param p The particle to calculate the force for.
     * @return A Vector representing the force.
     */
    private Vector calculateBarPotentialForce(Particle p) {
        // A simple, non-physical rotating bar potential for visual effect
        double barStrength = 1e6;
        double barAngle = 0.005 * currentTime; // Slowly rotate the bar
        
        double x_prime = p.x() * Math.cos(barAngle) + p.y() * Math.sin(barAngle);
        // Simple force model pulling towards the bar's major axis
        double forceMagnitude = -barStrength * x_prime * Math.exp(-p.distanceToCenter() / 5000.0);
        
        return new Vector(forceMagnitude * Math.cos(barAngle), forceMagnitude * Math.sin(barAngle));
    }
    
    /**
     * Calculates the total energy of the system (kinetic + potential).
     * Used for checking simulation stability.
     * @return The total energy of the system.
     */
    public double calculateTotalEnergy() {
        double kineticEnergy = 0;
        double potentialEnergy = 0;

        for (Particle p : particles) {
            // Kinetic energy: 0.5 * m * v^2
            kineticEnergy += 0.5 * p.mass() * (p.vx() * p.vx() + p.vy() * p.vy());
            
            // Potential energy: sum over pairs, -G * m1 * m2 / r
            // This is approximated using the tree to avoid O(n^2)
            if (barnesHutTree != null) {
                potentialEnergy += barnesHutTree.calculatePotential(p, G, THETA, SOFTENING);
            }
        }
        
        // The tree calculates potential per particle, so we must divide by 2
        return kineticEnergy + (potentialEnergy / 2.0);
    }
    
    public double getEnergyDrift() {
        if (initialEnergy == 0) return 0;
        return (calculateTotalEnergy() - initialEnergy) / initialEnergy;
    }

    // --- Getters and Setters ---

    public List<Particle> getParticles() { return particles; }
    public double getCurrentTime() { return currentTime; }
    public double getTimeScale() { return fastForward ? timeScale * 5.0 : timeScale; }
    public void setTimeScale(double scale) { this.timeScale = Math.max(1.0, scale); }
    public int getParticleCount() { return particleCount; }
    public double getCurrentEnergy() { return calculateTotalEnergy(); }
    public boolean isFastForward() { return fastForward; }
    public void setFastForward(boolean ff) { this.fastForward = ff; }
    public void setBarEnabled(boolean enabled) { this.barEnabled = enabled; }
    
    public void setParticleCount(int count) {
        this.particleCount = count;
        reset(); // Re-initialize the simulation with the new particle count
    }
}

/**
 * Barnes-Hut Quadtree implementation for efficient N-body force calculations.
 * Uses θ = 0.7 as the opening angle criterion for approximations.
 */
public class Quadtree {
    private static final double THETA = 0.7; // Opening angle criterion
    private static final int MAX_PARTICLES_PER_NODE = 1;

    private final double x, y, size; // Center and half-width of this node
    private double totalMass = 0;
    private double centerOfMassX = 0;
    private double centerOfMassY = 0;
    private List<Particle> particles = new ArrayList<>();

    // Child quadrants: NW, NE, SW, SE
    private Quadtree[] children = new Quadtree[4];
    private boolean hasChildren = false;

    public Quadtree(double centerX, double centerY, double halfSize) {
        this.x = centerX;
        this.y = centerY;
        this.size = halfSize;
    }

    /**
     * Inserts a particle into the quadtree
     */
    public void insert(Particle particle) {
        // Check if particle is within bounds
        if (!contains(particle.x(), particle.y())) {
            return;
        }

        totalMass += particle.mass();

        // Update center of mass
        if (totalMass > 0) {
            centerOfMassX = (centerOfMassX * (totalMass - particle.mass()) + particle.x() * particle.mass()) / totalMass;
            centerOfMassY = (centerOfMassY * (totalMass - particle.mass()) + particle.y() * particle.mass()) / totalMass;
        }

        if (!hasChildren && particles.size() < MAX_PARTICLES_PER_NODE) {
            // Add particle to this leaf node
            particles.add(particle);
        } else {
            // Need to subdivide or add to existing children
            if (!hasChildren) {
                subdivide();
                // Move existing particles to children
                for (Particle p : particles) {
                    addToChild(p);
                }
                particles.clear();
            }
            addToChild(particle);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Subdivides this node into four quadrants
     */
    private void subdivide() {
        double quarterSize = size / 2;
        children[0] = new Quadtree(x - quarterSize, y + quarterSize, quarterSize); // NW
        children[1] = new Quadtree(x + quarterSize, y + quarterSize, quarterSize); // NE
        children[2] = new Quadtree(x - quarterSize, y - quarterSize, quarterSize); // SW
        children[3] = new Quadtree(x + quarterSize, y - quarterSize, quarterSize); // SE
        hasChildren = true;
    }

    /**
     * Adds a particle to the appropriate child quadrant
     */
    private void addToChild(Particle particle) {
        for (Quadtree child : children) {
            if (child.contains(particle.x(), particle.y())) {
                child.insert(particle);
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Checks if a point is contained within this node
     */
    private boolean contains(double px, double py) {
        return px >= x - size && px < x + size && py >= y - size && py < y + size;
    }

    /**
     * Calculates gravitational force on a particle using Barnes-Hut approximation
     */
    public Force calculateForce(Particle particle) {
        if (totalMass == 0) {
            return new Force(0, 0);
        }

        double dx = centerOfMassX - particle.x();
        double dy = centerOfMassY - particle.y();
        double distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

        // Skip self-interaction
        if (distance < 1e-10) {
            return new Force(0, 0);
        }

        // Barnes-Hut criterion: if s/d < θ, treat as single body
        if (!hasChildren || size / distance < THETA) {
            return calculateDirectForce(particle, centerOfMassX, centerOfMassY, totalMass);
        } else {
            // Recursively calculate force from children
            Force totalForce = new Force(0, 0);
            for (Quadtree child : children) {
                if (child != null) {
                    Force childForce = child.calculateForce(particle);
                    totalForce = totalForce.add(childForce);
                }
            }
            return totalForce;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Calculates direct gravitational force between particle and a mass at given position
     */
    private Force calculateDirectForce(Particle particle, double massX, double massY, double mass) {
        double dx = massX - particle.x();
        double dy = massY - particle.y();
        double distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

        if (distance < 1e-10) {
            return new Force(0, 0);
        }

        // Apply gravitational softening
        double softening = particle.softeningParameter();
        double softenedDistance = Math.sqrt(distance * distance + softening * softening);

        // F = G * m1 * m2 / r^2, G = 4.302 × 10^-3 pc (M_sun)^-1 (km/s)^2
        final double G = 4.302e-3;
        double forceMagnitude = G * particle.mass() * mass / (softenedDistance * softenedDistance);

        // Unit vector components
        double ux = dx / distance;
        double uy = dy / distance;

        return new Force(forceMagnitude * ux, forceMagnitude * uy);
    }

    /**
     * Returns all particles in this quadtree (for visualization)
     */
    public List<Particle> getAllParticles() {
        List<Particle> allParticles = new ArrayList<>();
        if (hasChildren) {
            for (Quadtree child : children) {
                if (child != null) {
                    allParticles.addAll(child.getAllParticles());
                }
            }
        } else {
            allParticles.addAll(particles);
        }
        return allParticles;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the local density at this node for adaptive time-stepping
     */
    public double getDensity() {
        double volume = 4.0 * size * size; // 2D area
        return totalMass / volume;
    }

    /**
     * Returns bounds for visualization
     */
    public record Bounds(double x, double y, double size) {}

    /**
     * Gets all node bounds for quadtree visualization overlay
     */
    public List<Bounds> getAllBounds() {
        List<Bounds> bounds = new ArrayList<>();
        bounds.add(new Bounds(x, y, size));

        if (hasChildren) {
            for (Quadtree child : children) {
                if (child != null) {
                    bounds.addAll(child.getAllBounds());
                }
            }
        }
        return bounds;
    }

    /**
     * Represents a 2D force vector
     */
    public record Force(double fx, double fy) {
        public Force add(Force other) {
            return new Force(fx + other.fx, fy + other.fy);
        }

        public double magnitude() {
            return Math.sqrt(fx * fx + fy * fy);
        }
    }
}

```java
package com.example.galaxy_sim.simulation;

import com.example.galaxy_sim.model.Particle;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;
import java.util.Vector;

/**
 * Manages the state and progression of the galaxy simulation.
 * This class handles particle initialization, physics updates, and Barnes-Hut tree construction.
 */
public class Simulator {
	private List<Particle> particles;
	private BarnesHutTree barnesHutTree;
	private double currentTime = 0;
	private double initialEnergy = 0;
	private boolean barEnabled = false;
	private boolean fastForward = false;
	private int particleCount = 1000;
	private double timeScale = 100.0; // Default: 100 years/sec

	// Physical constants
	private static final double G = 4.30091e-3; // Gravitational constant in pc * (km/s)^2 / M_solar
	private static final double THETA = 0.5; // Barnes-Hut opening angle
	private static final double SOFTENING = 10.0; // Softening length in parsecs to prevent singularities

	public Simulator() {
		reset();
	}

	/**
	 * Resets the simulation to its initial state with the current particle count.
	 */
	public void reset() {
		this.particles = initializeParticles(this.particleCount);
		this.currentTime = 0;
		this.initialEnergy = calculateTotalEnergy();
	}

	/**
	 * Advances the simulation by a given time step (dt).
	 * @param dt The amount of time to simulate, in years.
	 */
	public void step(double dt) {
		// The simulation time step in internal units (Mega-years)
		// Convert dt from years to millions of years
		double timeStepMyr = dt / 1_000_000.0;

		// 1. Build the Barnes-Hut tree from the current particle distribution
		// The boundary needs to encompass all particles.
		Boundary simulationBoundary = Boundary.createFromParticles(particles);
		this.barnesHutTree = new BarnesHutTree(simulationBoundary);
		for (Particle p : particles) {
			barnesHutTree.insert(p);
		}

		// 2. Calculate forces for each particle
		for (Particle p : particles) {
			// Calculate gravitational force from the Barnes-Hut tree
			Vector force = barnesHutTree.calculateForce(p, G, THETA, SOFTENING);

			// Optionally, add the force from a central bar potential
			if (barEnabled) {
				force = force.add(calculateBarPotentialForce(p));
			}

			// 3. Update velocities (Leapfrog integrator - first half-step)
			// v(t + dt/2) = v(t) + a(t) * dt/2
			double ax = force.x() / p.mass();
			double ay = force.y() / p.mass();

			double vx_half = p.vx() + ax * timeStepMyr;
			double vy_half = p.vy() + ay * timeStepMyr;

			// 4. Update positions using the new velocities
			// x(t + dt) = x(t) + v(t + dt/2) * dt
			double newX = p.x() + vx_half * timeStepMyr;
			double newY = p.y() + vy_half * timeStepMyr;

			// For simplicity, we directly update the particle here.
			// A more robust implementation might store next state separately.
			p.setVx(vx_half);
			p.setVy(vy_half);
			p.setX(newX);
			p.setY(newY);
		}

		// This would be the second half-step of the leapfrog integrator, but we can simplify
		// by calculating the next-step force and doing the velocity update at the start of the next call.
		// For now, this kick-drift approach is a stable improvement.

		// 5. Advance simulation time
		this.currentTime += dt;
	}


	/**
	 * Initializes a set of particles representing a spiral galaxy.
	 * @param count The number of particles to create.
	 * @return A list of newly created particles.
	 */
	private List<Particle> initializeParticles(int count) {
		List<Particle> newParticles = new ArrayList<>();
		Random rand = new Random();

		// Galaxy properties
		double bulgeMass = 1e10; // M_solar
		double diskMass = 5e10; // M_solar
		double diskRadius = 15000; // parsecs
		double bulgeRadius = 3000; // parsecs

		int bulgeCount = count / 5;
		int diskCount = count - bulgeCount;

		// Create bulge particles (spherical distribution)
		for (int i = 0; i < bulgeCount; i++) {
			double r = bulgeRadius * Math.pow(rand.nextDouble(), 0.5); // Hernquist profile approximation
			double theta = 2 * Math.PI * rand.nextDouble();
			double phi = Math.acos(2 * rand.nextDouble() - 1);

			double x = r * Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta);
			double y = r * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta);

			// Velocity for circular orbit in a spherical potential
			double v = Math.sqrt(G * bulgeMass / (r + SOFTENING));
			double vx = -v * Math.sin(theta);
			double vy = v * Math.cos(theta);

			newParticles.add(new Particle(x, y, vx, vy, bulgeMass / bulgeCount, Particle.StellarType.GIANT));
		}

		// Create disk particles (exponential disk)
		for (int i = 0; i < diskCount; i++) {
			double r = diskRadius * Math.sqrt(rand.nextDouble()); // More uniform density
			double theta = 2 * Math.PI * rand.nextDouble();

			double x = r * Math.cos(theta);
			double y = r * Math.sin(theta);

			// Velocity for circular orbit in a disk potential
			double totalMassInside = bulgeMass + diskMass * (r / diskRadius);
			double v = Math.sqrt(G * totalMassInside / (r + SOFTENING));

			double vx = -v * Math.sin(theta);
			double vy = v * Math.cos(theta);

			newParticles.add(new Particle(x, y, vx, vy, diskMass / diskCount, Particle.StellarType.MAIN_SEQUENCE));
		}

		return newParticles;
	}

	/**
	 * Calculates the force exerted by a central bar potential on a particle.
	 * @param p The particle to calculate the force for.
	 * @return A Vector representing the force.
	 */
	private Vector calculateBarPotentialForce(Particle p) {
		// A simple, non-physical rotating bar potential for visual effect
		double barStrength = 1e6;
		double barAngle = 0.005 * currentTime; // Slowly rotate the bar

		double x_prime = p.x() * Math.cos(barAngle) + p.y() * Math.sin(barAngle);
		// Simple force model pulling towards the bar's major axis
		double forceMagnitude = -barStrength * x_prime * Math.exp(-p.distanceToCenter() / 5000.0);

		return new Vector(forceMagnitude * Math.cos(barAngle), forceMagnitude * Math.sin(barAngle));
	}

	/**
	 * Calculates the total energy of the system (kinetic + potential).
	 * Used for checking simulation stability.
	 * @return The total energy of the system.
	 */
	public double calculateTotalEnergy() {
		double kineticEnergy = 0;
		double potentialEnergy = 0;

		for (Particle p : particles) {
			// Kinetic energy: 0.5 * m * v^2
			kineticEnergy += 0.5 * p.mass() * (p.vx() * p.vx() + p.vy() * p.vy());

			// Potential energy: sum over pairs, -G * m1 * m2 / r
			// This is approximated using the tree to avoid O(n^2)
			if (barnesHutTree != null) {
				potentialEnergy += barnesHutTree.calculatePotential(p, G, THETA, SOFTENING);
			}
		}

		// The tree calculates potential per particle, so we must divide by 2
		return kineticEnergy + (potentialEnergy / 2.0);
	}

	public double getEnergyDrift() {
		if (initialEnergy == 0) return 0;
		return (calculateTotalEnergy() - initialEnergy) / initialEnergy;
	}

	// --- Getters and Setters ---

	public List<Particle> getParticles() { return particles; }
	public double getCurrentTime() { return currentTime; }
	public double getTimeScale() { return fastForward ? timeScale * 5.0 : timeScale; }
	public void setTimeScale(double scale) { this.timeScale = Math.max(1.0, scale); }
	public int getParticleCount() { return particleCount; }
	public double getCurrentEnergy() { return calculateTotalEnergy(); }
	public boolean isFastForward() { return fastForward; }
	public void setFastForward(boolean ff) { this.fastForward = ff; }
	public void setBarEnabled(boolean enabled) { this.barEnabled = enabled; }

	public void setParticleCount(int count) {
		this.particleCount = count;
		reset(); // Re-initialize the simulation with the new particle count
	}
}

package com.example.galaxy_sim.physics;

import com.example.galaxy_sim.model.Particle;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Barnes-Hut Quadtree implementation for efficient N-body force calculations.
 */
public class Quadtree {
    private final double x, y, size; // Center and half-width of this node
    private double totalMass = 0;
    private double centerOfMassX = 0;
    private double centerOfMassY = 0;
    private Particle particleInNode; // If it's a leaf node with one particle

    // Child quadrants: NW, NE, SW, SE
    private Quadtree[] children = new Quadtree[4];
    private boolean isLeaf = true;

    public Quadtree(double centerX, double centerY, double halfSize) {
        this.x = centerX;
        this.y = centerY;
        this.size = halfSize;
    }

    /**
     * Inserts a particle into the quadtree.
     */
    public void insert(Particle p) {
        if (!contains(p.x(), p.y())) {
            return;
        }

        if (isLeaf) {
            if (particleInNode == null) {
                // This leaf is empty, store the particle here.
                particleInNode = p;
                totalMass = p.mass();
                centerOfMassX = p.x();
                centerOfMassY = p.y();
                return;
            } else {
                // This leaf is occupied, we must subdivide.
                subdivide();
                // Re-insert the original particle into the correct child.
                addToChild(particleInNode);
                particleInNode = null; // No longer a leaf with a single particle.
            }
        }

        // Add the new particle to the correct child.
        addToChild(p);
        // Update this node's center of mass.
        updateCenterOfMass(p);
    }
    
    private void updateCenterOfMass(Particle p) {
        centerOfMassX = (centerOfMassX * totalMass + p.x() * p.mass()) / (totalMass + p.mass());
        centerOfMassY = (centerOfMassY * totalMass + p.y() * p.mass()) / (totalMass + p.mass());
        totalMass += p.mass();
    }

    private void subdivide() {
        double quarterSize = size / 2;
        children[0] = new Quadtree(x - quarterSize, y - quarterSize, quarterSize); // SW
        children[1] = new Quadtree(x + quarterSize, y - quarterSize, quarterSize); // SE
        children[2] = new Quadtree(x - quarterSize, y + quarterSize, quarterSize); // NW
        children[3] = new Quadtree(x + quarterSize, y + quarterSize, quarterSize); // NE
        isLeaf = false;
    }

    private void addToChild(Particle p) {
        for (Quadtree child : children) {
            if (child.contains(p.x(), p.y())) {
                child.insert(p);
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    private boolean contains(double px, double py) {
        return px >= x - size && px <= x + size && py >= y - size && py <= y + size;
    }

    /**
     * Calculates gravitational force on a particle using Barnes-Hut approximation.
     */
    public Force calculateForce(Particle p, double G, double theta, double softening) {
        Force totalForce = new Force(0, 0);

        if (isLeaf) {
            if (particleInNode != null && particleInNode != p) {
                totalForce = totalForce.add(calculateDirectForce(p, particleInNode, G, softening));
            }
        } else {
            double dx = centerOfMassX - p.x();
            double dy = centerOfMassY - p.y();
            double distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

            // If node is far enough away, approximate it as a single mass.
            if ((2 * size) / distance < theta) {
                totalForce = totalForce.add(calculateDirectForce(p, totalMass, centerOfMassX, centerOfMassY, G, softening));
            } else {
                // Otherwise, recurse into children.
                for (Quadtree child : children) {
                    if (child.totalMass > 0) {
                        totalForce = totalForce.add(child.calculateForce(p, G, theta, softening));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return totalForce;
    }

    /**
     * Calculates potential energy on a particle.
     */
    public double calculatePotential(Particle p, double G, double theta, double softening) {
        double totalPotential = 0.0;

        if (isLeaf) {
            if (particleInNode != null && particleInNode != p) {
                double dx = particleInNode.x() - p.x();
                double dy = particleInNode.y() - p.y();
                double softenedDist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + softening * softening);
                totalPotential -= G * p.mass() * particleInNode.mass() / softenedDist;
            }
        } else {
             double dx = centerOfMassX - p.x();
             double dy = centerOfMassY - p.y();
             double distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
             
            if ((2 * size) / distance < theta) {
                double softenedDist = Math.sqrt(distance * distance + softening * softening);
                totalPotential -= G * p.mass() * totalMass / softenedDist;
            } else {
                for (Quadtree child : children) {
                    if (child.totalMass > 0) {
                        totalPotential += child.calculatePotential(p, G, theta, softening);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return totalPotential;
    }

    private Force calculateDirectForce(Particle p1, Particle p2, double G, double softening) {
        return calculateDirectForce(p1, p2.mass(), p2.x(), p2.y(), G, softening);
    }
    
    private Force calculateDirectForce(Particle p, double mass, double massX, double massY, double G, double softening) {
        double dx = massX - p.x();
        double dy = massY - p.y();
        double distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
        double dist = Math.sqrt(distSq);

        // Avoid self-interaction and division by zero
        if (dist < 1e-9) {
            return new Force(0, 0);
        }
        
        double softenedDistSq = distSq + softening * softening;
        double forceMag = (G * p.mass() * mass) / softenedDistSq;

        return new Force(forceMag * dx / dist, forceMag * dy / dist);
    }

    /** Represents a 2D force vector. */
    public record Force(double fx, double fy) {
        public Force add(Force other) {
            return new Force(fx + other.fx, fy + other.fy);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.galaxy_sim.simulation;

import com.example.galaxy_sim.model.Particle;
import com.example.galaxy_sim.physics.Quadtree;
import com.example.galaxy_sim.physics.Quadtree.Force;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Manages the state and progression of the galaxy simulation.
 */
public class Simulator {
    private List<Particle> particles;
    private Quadtree quadtree;
    private double currentTime = 0;
    private double initialEnergy = 0;
    private boolean barEnabled = false;
    private boolean fastForward = false;
    private int particleCount = 1000;
    private double timeScale = 100000.0; // Adjusted default for better interaction

    // Physical constants
    private static final double G = 4.30091e-3; // pc*(km/s)^2 / M_solar
    private static final double THETA = 0.7;    // Barnes-Hut opening angle
    private static final double SOFTENING = 15.0; // pc

    public Simulator() {
        reset();
    }

    public void reset() {
        this.particles = initializeParticles(this.particleCount);
        this.currentTime = 0;
        // Build an initial tree to calculate initial energy
        buildTree();
        this.initialEnergy = calculateTotalEnergy();
    }

    private void buildTree() {
        // Calculate the bounding box that contains all particles
        double minX = Double.MAX_VALUE, maxX = Double.MIN_VALUE;
        double minY = Double.MAX_VALUE, maxY = Double.MIN_VALUE;
        for (Particle p : particles) {
            if (p.x() < minX) minX = p.x();
            if (p.x() > maxX) maxX = p.x();
            if (p.y() < minY) minY = p.y();
            if (p.y() > maxY) maxY = p.y();
        }

        // Create a square boundary
        double size = Math.max(maxX - minX, maxY - minY);
        double centerX = (minX + maxX) / 2.0;
        double centerY = (minY + maxY) / 2.0;
        
        // Add a buffer to the size to ensure all particles are contained
        this.quadtree = new Quadtree(centerX, centerY, size);
        for (Particle p : particles) {
            quadtree.insert(p);
        }
    }

    public void step(double dt) {
        // Convert dt from years to the simulation's time unit (millions of years)
        double timeStepMyr = dt / 1_000_000.0;
        
        // 1. Build the Barnes-Hut quadtree
        buildTree();

        // 2. Update particle positions and velocities
        List<Particle> nextParticles = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Particle p : particles) {
            // Calculate force on the particle
            Force force = quadtree.calculateForce(p, G, THETA, SOFTENING);

            if (barEnabled) {
                force = force.add(calculateBarPotentialForce(p));
            }

            // Update velocity (Leapfrog integrator: kick)
            double ax = force.fx() / p.mass();
            double ay = force.fy() / p.mass();
            double newVx = p.vx() + ax * timeStepMyr;
            double newVy = p.vy() + ay * timeStepMyr;
            
            // Update position (Leapfrog integrator: drift)
            double newX = p.x() + newVx * timeStepMyr;
            double newY = p.y() + newVy * timeStepMyr;

            // Create a new particle for the next state
            Particle nextP = new Particle(newX, newY, newVx, newVy, p.mass(), p.stellarType());
            nextP.setAge(p.age() + dt); // Also advance particle age
            nextParticles.add(nextP);
        }
        
        // Update the main particle list
        this.particles = nextParticles;

        // 3. Advance simulation time
        this.currentTime += dt;
    }

    private List<Particle> initializeParticles(int count) {
        List<Particle> newParticles = new ArrayList<>();
        Random rand = new Random();

        double bulgeMass = 1e10;
        double diskMass = 5e10;
        double diskRadius = 15000;
        double bulgeRadius = 3000;

        int bulgeCount = count / 5;
        int diskCount = count - bulgeCount;

        for (int i = 0; i < bulgeCount; i++) {
            double r = bulgeRadius * Math.pow(rand.nextDouble(), 0.5);
            double theta = 2 * Math.PI * rand.nextDouble();
            double phi = Math.acos(2 * rand.nextDouble() - 1);
            double x = r * Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta);
            double y = r * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta);
            double v = Math.sqrt(G * bulgeMass / (r + SOFTENING));
            double vx = -v * Math.sin(theta);
            double vy = v * Math.cos(theta);
            newParticles.add(new Particle(x, y, vx, vy, bulgeMass / bulgeCount, Particle.StellarType.GIANT));
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < diskCount; i++) {
            double r = diskRadius * Math.sqrt(rand.nextDouble());
            double theta = 2 * Math.PI * rand.nextDouble();
            double x = r * Math.cos(theta);
            double y = r * Math.sin(theta);
            double totalMassInside = bulgeMass + diskMass * (r / diskRadius);
            double v = Math.sqrt(G * totalMassInside / (r + SOFTENING));
            double vx = -v * Math.sin(theta);
            double vy = v * Math.cos(theta);
            newParticles.add(new Particle(x, y, vx, vy, diskMass / diskCount, Particle.StellarType.MAIN_SEQUENCE));
        }

        return newParticles;
    }

    private Force calculateBarPotentialForce(Particle p) {
        // This is a non-physical force for visual effect
        return new Force(0,0); // Disabled for now to ensure stability
    }
    
    public double calculateTotalEnergy() {
        double kineticEnergy = 0;
        double potentialEnergy = 0;

        for (Particle p : particles) {
            kineticEnergy += 0.5 * p.mass() * (p.vx() * p.vx() + p.vy() * p.vy());
            if (quadtree != null) {
                potentialEnergy += quadtree.calculatePotential(p, G, THETA, SOFTENING);
            }
        }
        return kineticEnergy + (potentialEnergy / 2.0); // Potential is double-counted
    }
    
    public double getEnergyDrift() {
        if (initialEnergy == 0) return 0;
        return (calculateTotalEnergy() - initialEnergy) / initialEnergy;
    }

    // --- Getters and Setters ---
    public List<Particle> getParticles() { return particles; }
    public double getCurrentTime() { return currentTime; }
    public double getTimeScale() { return fastForward ? timeScale * 5.0 : timeScale; }
    public void setTimeScale(double scale) { this.timeScale = Math.max(1.0, scale); }
    public int getParticleCount() { return particleCount; }
    public double getCurrentEnergy() { return calculateTotalEnergy(); }
    public boolean isFastForward() { return fastForward; }
    public void setFastForward(boolean ff) { this.fastForward = ff; }
    public void setBarEnabled(boolean enabled) { this.barEnabled = enabled; }
    
    public void setParticleCount(int count) {
        this.particleCount = count;
        reset();
    }
}

			if (p.x() < minX) minX = p.x();
			if (p.x() > maxX) maxX = p.x();
			if (p.y() < minY) minY = p.y();
			if (p.y() > maxY) maxY = p.y();
		}

		// Create a square boundary
		double size = Math.max(maxX - minX, maxY - minY);
		double centerX = (minX + maxX) / 2.0;
		double centerY = (minY + maxY) / 2.0;

		// Add a buffer to the size to ensure all particles are contained
		this.quadtree = new Quadtree(centerX, centerY, size * 1.2);
		for (Particle p : particles) {
			quadtree.insert(p);
		}
	}

	public void step(double dt) {
		// Convert dt from years to the simulation's time unit (millions of years)
		double timeStepMyr = dt / 1_000_000.0;

		// 1. Build the Barnes-Hut quadtree
		buildTree();

		// 2. Update particle positions and velocities
		List<Particle> nextParticles = new ArrayList<>();
		for (Particle p : particles) {
			// Calculate force on the particle
			Force force = quadtree.calculateForce(p, G, THETA, SOFTENING);

			if (barEnabled) {
				force = force.add(calculateBarPotentialForce(p));
			}

			// Update velocity (Leapfrog integrator: kick)
			double ax = force.fx() / p.mass();
			double ay = force.fy() / p.mass();
			double newVx = p.vx() + ax * timeStepMyr;
			double newVy = p.vy() + ay * timeStepMyr;

			// Update position (Leapfrog integrator: drift)
			double newX = p.x() + newVx * timeStepMyr;
			double newY = p.y() + newVy * timeStepMyr;

			// Create a new, immutable particle for the next state using the full constructor
			Particle nextP = new Particle(newX, newY, newVx, newVy, p.mass(), p.stellarType(), p.age() + dt, p.metallicity());
			nextParticles.add(nextP);
		}

		// Update the main particle list
		this.particles = nextParticles;

		// 3. Advance simulation time
		this.currentTime += dt;
	}

	private List<Particle> initializeParticles(int count) {
		List<Particle> newParticles = new ArrayList<>();
		Random rand = new Random();

		double bulgeMass = 1e10;
		double diskMass = 5e10;
		double diskRadius = 15000;
		double bulgeRadius = 3000;

		int bulgeCount = count / 5;
		int diskCount = count - bulgeCount;

		for (int i = 0; i < bulgeCount; i++) {
			double r = bulgeRadius * Math.pow(rand.nextDouble(), 0.5);
			double theta = 2 * Math.PI * rand.nextDouble();
			double phi = Math.acos(2 * rand.nextDouble() - 1);
			double x = r * Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta);
			double y = r * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta);
			double v = Math.sqrt(G * bulgeMass / (r + SOFTENING));
			double vx = -v * Math.sin(theta);
			double vy = v * Math.cos(theta);
			newParticles.add(new Particle(x, y, vx, vy, bulgeMass / bulgeCount, Particle.StellarType.GIANT));
		}

		for (int i = 0; i < diskCount; i++) {
			double r = diskRadius * Math.sqrt(rand.nextDouble());
			double theta = 2 * Math.PI * rand.nextDouble();
			double x = r * Math.cos(theta);
			double y = r * Math.sin(theta);
			double totalMassInside = bulgeMass + diskMass * (r / diskRadius);
			double v = Math.sqrt(G * totalMassInside / (r + SOFTENING));
			double vx = -v * Math.sin(theta);
			double vy = v * Math.cos(theta);
			newParticles.add(new Particle(x, y, vx, vy, diskMass / diskCount, Particle.StellarType.MAIN_SEQUENCE));
		}

		return newParticles;
	}

	private Force calculateBarPotentialForce(Particle p) {
		// This is a non-physical force for visual effect
		return new Force(0,0); // Disabled for now to ensure stability
	}

	public double calculateTotalEnergy() {
		double kineticEnergy = 0;
		double potentialEnergy = 0;

		for (Particle p : particles) {
			kineticEnergy += 0.5 * p.mass() * (p.vx() * p.vx() + p.vy() * p.vy());
			if (quadtree != null) {
				potentialEnergy += quadtree.calculatePotential(p, G, THETA, SOFTENING);
			}
		}
		return kineticEnergy + (potentialEnergy / 2.0); // Potential is double-counted
	}

	public double getEnergyDrift() {
		if (initialEnergy == 0) return 0;
		return (calculateTotalEnergy() - initialEnergy) / initialEnergy;
	}

	// --- Getters and Setters ---
	public List<Particle> getParticles() { return particles; }
	public double getCurrentTime() { return currentTime; }
	public double getTimeScale() { return fastForward ? timeScale * 5.0 : timeScale; }
	public void setTimeScale(double scale) { this.timeScale = Math.max(1.0, scale); }
	public int getParticleCount() { return particleCount; }
	public double getCurrentEnergy() { return calculateTotalEnergy(); }
	public boolean isFastForward() { return fastForward; }
	public void setFastForward(boolean ff) { this.fastForward = ff; }
	public void setBarEnabled(boolean enabled) { this.barEnabled = enabled; }

	public void setParticleCount(int count) {
		this.particleCount = count;
		reset();
	}
}

```java
package com.example.galaxy_sim.model;

/**
 * Represents a particle in the galaxy simulation with position, velocity, mass,
 * and stellar properties. Designed for extensibility with Drake simulation features.
 *
 * Each particle represents approximately 10^6 solar masses of stellar material.
 */
public record Particle(
    double x, double y,           // Position in parsecs
    double vx, double vy,         // Velocity in km/s
    double mass,                  // Mass in solar masses (~10^6)
    StellarType stellarType,      // Main sequence, giant, etc.
    double age,                   // Age in Gyr
    double metallicity,           // Metallicity [Fe/H]
    boolean habitable,            // Habitability flag for Drake simulation
    double distanceToSMBH         // Distance to SMBH in parsecs
) {

    public enum StellarType {
        MAIN_SEQUENCE,    // Disk population
        GIANT,            // Bulge population
        SUPERGIANT,       // Rare massive stars
        WHITE_DWARF       // End-stage stars
    }

    /**
     * Creates a new particle with updated position and velocity
     */
    public Particle withPosition(double newX, double newY) {
        return new Particle(newX, newY, vx, vy, mass, stellarType, age, metallicity, habitable, distanceToSMBH);
    }

    /**
     * Creates a new particle with updated velocity
     */
    public Particle withVelocity(double newVx, double newVy) {
        return new Particle(x, y, newVx, newVy, mass, stellarType, age, metallicity, habitable, distanceToSMBH);
    }

    /**
     * Creates a new particle with updated distance to SMBH
     */
    public Particle withDistanceToSMBH(double newDistance) {
        return new Particle(x, y, vx, vy, mass, stellarType, age, metallicity, habitable, newDistance);
    }

    /**
     * Calculates habitability probability based on metallicity and SMBH proximity
     * P_life ∝ metallicity × exp(-r/r_SMBH), r_SMBH ≈ 100 pc
     */
    public double habitabilityProbability() {
        final double r_SMBH = 100.0; // parsecs
        return metallicity * Math.exp(-distanceToSMBH / r_SMBH);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the gravitational softening parameter for this particle
     */
    public double softeningParameter() {
        return 10.0; // ε = 10 pc for particle-particle interactions
    }
}
